newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George lower costs help lift net.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George lower costs help lift net.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday the 17.7 percent rise in net profit to A$159.51 million for the year to September 30, 1996 reflected a continued reduction in costs and strong management of margins.
St George reported a net profit before preference dividends of A$148.3 million for the year, a rise of 9.4 percent.

"This is a solid result under intense competitive pressures which reflects a continued reduction in our cost ratios and strong management of our margins," managing director Jim Sweeney said in a statement.
